name: Grid
description: Multi-select card grid for media assets, project cards, social media posts, screenshots and user records. Pairs card selection checkboxes, inline and ⋯ secondary item actions, a select-all toolbar and the floating bottom Action bar.

classes.ayy-grid-wrap: Stack wrapper grouping the grid toolbar, the card grid and the floating Action bar.
classes.ayy-grid__toolbar: Header bar above the grid holding the select-all checkbox, count and sorting or view controls.
classes.ayy-grid__select-all: Labelled select-all checkbox control in the grid toolbar.
classes.ayy-grid: Responsive CSS grid container: as many card columns of at least --ayy-min (16rem) as fit.
classes.ayy-grid--compact: Dense variant (--ayy-min: 13rem, tighter gap and card padding) for media libraries and directories.
classes.ayy-grid__item: Selectable record card (<article>). Highlights with a 2px text-colour border and tint when aria-selected="true".
classes.ayy-grid__media: Top preview frame for images, screenshots, social post visuals or video thumbnails. Floating glass corners when .ayy-grid__select or .ayy-grid__actions sit inside.
classes.ayy-grid__header: Top block of the card holding the checkbox, avatar/icon, title, description and item actions.
classes.ayy-grid__select: Wrapper for the card's selection Checkbox (inline in the header or floating in the top-start corner of .ayy-grid__media).
classes.ayy-grid__actions: Cluster of quick action buttons (Edit, Copy) and the ⋯ DropdownMenu trigger (inline in the header or floating in the top-end corner of .ayy-grid__media).
classes.ayy-grid__actions--reveal: Reveals item actions when the card is hovered, focused within, selected or has an open menu (stays visible on touch screens).
classes.ayy-grid__description: Muted subtitle, handle or supporting metadata line.
classes.ayy-grid__body: Card body content between header and footer.
classes.ayy-grid__footer: Bottom bar for status Badges, timestamps or avatars, pinned to the bottom of stretched cards.

default.looks: Responsive grid of surface cards with line borders, rest shadow, optional top media preview, header, body and hairline footer.

hover.looks: Card border turns line-hover and reveals .ayy-grid__actions--reveal.

pressed.none: No pressed look; clicking a selectable card or its checkbox toggles selection on release.

focus.looks: Reveals .ayy-grid__actions--reveal while any checkbox, button or menu trigger inside the card has keyboard focus.

disabled.none: Cards aren't disabled; disable the controls inside them.

selected.looks: Text-colour border plus a 1px ring and a 4% text tint over the surface. Forced colours: Highlight outline.

error.none: Show a failed load as an Alert with a retry instead of the grid.

loading.none: No loading look; render Skeleton cards in the grid layout with aria-busy on the container.

sizes.density: Card padding is fixed (16px, 12px when compact); checkboxes and action buttons inside follow data-density.
sizes.width: Fills its container with auto-fitting columns at least --ayy-min wide (16rem default, 13rem compact).

js: gridClass({ compact?, className? }) → string; gridItemActionsClass({ reveal?, className? }) → string; gridWrapClass, gridToolbarClass, gridSelectAllClass, gridItemClass, gridMediaClass, gridHeaderClass, gridSelectClass, gridActionsClass, gridTitleClass, gridDescriptionClass, gridBodyClass, gridFooterClass constants; connectGrid(root, { onSelectionChange? }) wires select-all, card checkboxes, card-body click selection and Shift+click range selection (used by <ayy-grid>).

element.description: Wraps an .ayy-grid-wrap or .ayy-grid. Wires the .ayy-grid__select-all checkbox (including indeterminate state), each card's .ayy-grid__select checkbox, card-body click-to-select, and Shift+click range selection.

react.import: import { GridWrap, GridToolbar, GridSelectAll, Grid, GridItem, GridItemMedia, GridItemHeader, GridItemSelect, GridItemActions, GridItemTitle, GridItemDescription, GridItemBody, GridItemFooter } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";

props.compact: boolean — denser cards and 13rem minimum column width

props.onSelectedChange: (selected: boolean) => void — toggles selection when the card body is clicked

props.reveal: boolean — reveal on card hover, focus-within or selection (stays visible on touch)

a11y: Each selectable card contains a native Checkbox in GridItemSelect with an aria-label naming the item ("Select Hero screenshot").
Selected cards carry aria-selected="true" and a 2px border (Highlight outline in High Contrast mode), never colour alone.
Per-card icon buttons and ⋯ DropdownMenu triggers carry an aria-label naming the item ("More actions for Hero screenshot").
GridItemActions with reveal uses opacity so controls remain in the Tab order and become visible on :focus-within.
do: Use Grid when items are browsed visually or as cards — media assets, screenshots, social media posts, projects and user records — and need multi-select and per-item actions like a Table.
Put GridItemSelect and GridItemActions inside GridItemMedia for visual cards (screenshots, media, social posts), or inside GridItemHeader for record cards (projects, users).
Provide a ⋯ DropdownMenu on each card for targeted secondary actions (Edit, Duplicate, Copy, Archive, Delete) and an ActionBar at the bottom for bulk actions on selected cards.
dont: Don't use Grid for static marketing feature tiles that aren't selectable records — use plain Cards in an .ayy-grid layout.
Don't use Grid for single-choice form inputs (like picking a pricing plan) — use ChoiceCard.
Don't hide the selection checkbox on selected cards.
